rationale.load: Keep the self-contained explorer under a 512 KiB Cytoscape asset plus small application shell.
rationale.layout: Refuse before layout when a slice exceeds 2500 nodes or 5000 edges.
rationale.evidence: Keep source-site rendering bounded even when a relation has high degree.
rationale.interaction: Reduced-motion users receive zero-duration camera transitions.
rationale.measurement: Thresholds are checked against three reproducible headless Chromium fixtures covering small, mixed-degree, and high-degree graphs; recorded baselines and environment are in performance-measurements.json.
